title: Users
description: Manage accounts, assign roles and block access.
extraPermissions: +{count, plural, one {# individual permission} other {# individual permissions}}
unverifiedHint: The email address has not been confirmed yet – sign-in is only possible after confirmation.
lockedHint: This account has permissions you don't have yourself. Only someone with at least the same permissions can change, disable or delete it.
lockedShort: More permissions than you – cannot be changed
permissionsHint: In addition to the roles. You can only grant permissions you have yourself.
createDescription: The account is active immediately. The password must be at least 12 characters long.
name: Name
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. The person can change it in their profile afterwards.
avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. After selecting, you choose the crop; it is saved immediately.
sectionError: This section could not be loaded.
sectionSavesItself: This section saves on its own.
unsavedChangesBoth: Unsaved changes in account and roles
avatarRemoveDescription: {name} will then be shown with initials.
deleteDescription: “{name}” ({email}) will be permanently deleted. Alternatively, you can disable the account.
deleteDetails: Deleting the account also removes the person's own files (including public links), the profile picture, offices with a personal description and the links to members. Events, galleries and actions of this person are transferred to you.

server.passwordMin: Password must be at least 12 characters long
server.imageTooLarge: The image must not be larger than 2 MB
server.notOnSelf: Please use your profile for your own account.
server.blockedWhileImpersonating: This is blocked while you are acting as another user.
server.noAdminTarget: Nobody can act as an administrator.
server.createdInviteFailed: Account created, but the invitation was not sent: {reason}

inviteHint: The person sets their own password via a link (valid for 7 days). Requires email delivery.

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.confirmDescription: Applies to {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}. Accounts with more permissions than yours and your own account are skipped.
bulk.done: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} updated

detail.selfHint: This is your own account. Change your password, 2FA and sessions in your profile.

stats.accessValue: {roles, plural, one {# role} other {# roles}} · {permissions, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}}

detail.activityDescription: Audit log entries triggered by this person, per day.

chart.summary: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} on {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
chart.aria: Activity over the last 90 days, {count} entries
chart.empty: No activity in the last 90 days.

audit.byImpersonation: by an administrator on their behalf

detail.sessionsDescription: Valid sessions. Ending one signs the device out immediately.
detail.revokeAllDescription: {name} is signed out on all devices and has to sign in again.
detail.readOnly: You can only view this account.
detail.passwordDescription: The person sets their password themselves (email or link) – or you set one.
detail.sendResetDescription: A link (valid for 1 hour) is sent to {email}. The current password stays valid until a new one is set.
detail.linkHint: Visible only now, valid for 1 hour, usable once. Only give it to the person themselves.
detail.setPasswordDescription: New password for {name}. All devices are signed out.
detail.passwordManualHint: At least 12 characters. Shown only now.
detail.mustChangeHint: The person can only continue after setting their own password.
detail.sessionsEndHint: Open reset links expire and all sessions end.
detail.generatedHint: Visible only now. Pass it on to the person securely.
detail.resetTwoFactorDescription: {name} then signs in with the password only and can set up 2FA again in the profile. All devices are signed out.
detail.deactivateDescription: {name} is signed out and cannot sign in until the account is active again.
detail.impersonateDescription: You see and change everything with this person’s permissions until you stop or the time runs out.
detail.impersonateWarning: Every action is logged with your name. The person’s password, 2FA, sessions, email and API keys stay locked. Depending on the settings, the person is notified by email.
detail.reasonHint: Stored and shown on the detail page (not to the person).

server.sessionsRevoked: {count, plural, =0 {No session ended} one {# session ended} other {# sessions ended}}
